emails.subject: [URGENT] Overdue Data Queries - Protocol SP-123, Site 102
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Please see the attached report regarding a high number of overdue data queries for Site 102 (University Medical Center). There are currently 85 queries outstanding for over 14 days, which is significantly impacting our timelines for the upcoming data lock.

Could you please follow up with the site to get these resolved as soon as possible?

Thanks,

Maria Garcia
Data Manager
ClinData Solutions

emails.subject: Re: [URGENT] Overdue Data Queries - Protocol SP-123, Site 102
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for reaching out. Apologies for the delay in query resolution. We've had some unexpected staffing shortages over the past few weeks which has created a significant backlog.

The list of 85 queries is quite overwhelming for our current capacity. To help us tackle this efficiently, could you help us prioritize which queries are the most critical to address first, for instance, those related to primary endpoint data?

Any guidance would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

David Chen
Study Coordinator
University Medical Center

description: A multi-email exchange with the data management team and the Study Coordinator at Site 102. The initial email from the data manager flags a high number of overdue data queries for the site. Alex Johnson forwards this to the site coordinator, who replies explaining they are short-staffed. Alex then works with them to prioritize the most critical queries related to primary endpoint data and sets up a call to help resolve the backlog.
